description: Two switches that cut the flow of a signal, by hand or from a trigger, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

params.text: Cuts that row's signal, and passes it again when pressed a second time
Chooses when the two lamps light: while their row is cut, or while it is passing

inputs.text: The signal that row cuts or passes
A trigger here passes that row's signal whatever state it was in
A trigger here cuts that row's signal, and a second trigger passes it again

outputs.text: The signal from that row's input while the row is passing, and silence while it is cut

notes: Both rows come up passing their signal, and whether each row is cut is saved with the patch.
